body:
After reading many experience reports, and doing extensive herb research on my own, I decided to make my own version of the Kinnikinnick I have tried at festivals and PowWows.  My husband works nights, so I was alone as usual, and in the mood for experimentation.
I made a mixture of uva ursi (bearberry), catnip, passionflower and some peppermint for flavor.  I loaded up, lit up and toked away.  All I can say is oh yeah.  The mix left me with a relaxed, happy, easy groove.  Tasted nice, not too harsh.  I was not muzzy and disconnected like some cannabis highs I have experienced, just relaxed and upbeat.  I noticed a definite lessening of the normal tensions of the day, enhanced spiritual awareness, and a general feeling of well-being.   I will definitely be making and using this mix again.
